newsitem.title: CANADA: CT says CIBC rumor not worthy of comment.
newsitem.headline: CT says CIBC rumor not worthy of comment.

text.p: CT Financial Services Inc's Canada Trust unit said on Friday it did not plan a formal statement on a published report it was in takeover talks with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, saying it was "not worthy of comment."
"It's all rumor and speculation and as such not worthy of comment," Canada Trust spokesman Mark Towhey told Reuters.
The Toronto Stock Exchange halted trading in CT shares after Toronto's Financial Post reported on Friday that CIBC was in "top secret talks" to acquire Canada Trust in a possible C$4.8 billion deal.
CIBC declined comment on the report.
CT shares remained halted in Toronto. CIBC was up 0.55 to 38.20 in Toronto, while shares in Imasco Ltd, CT's majority owner, rose 1.75 to 43.40.
